create.title: Pointwise two-shift bound for the terminal M2 frequency block
create.statement_tex: Let 1<=L<=H<=D<=X^(1/2). If u_L is supported on h asymp L with sup|u_L|+sum|Delta u_L| << 1/L and |w_D(d)|<<1 on d asymp D, then for rho in {1,3}, |sum_d w_D(d) sum_h u_L(h)e(h(X/d+rho)/4)| <<_epsilon X^epsilon(1+D/L). The actual Vaaler block satisfies the BV hypothesis. Hence every terminal block L asymp H_D asymp D X^(-1/4) is pointwise O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)), uniformly for X^(1/4)<=D<=X^(1/2). This does not bound the lower frequency blocks.
create.next_action: Use T2S to remove L asymp H_D from every M2 case split. Do not extrapolate D/L to lower blocks; map the remaining (D,L) region with direct and transformed estimates.

create.title: Exact generic single-lift coefficient and pair-fiber algebra
create.statement_tex: For reduced p/q with D<=q<2D, the only lift is g=1, so A_chi(p/q)=beta_{p,H}w_D(q), with beta_{p,H}=-Phi(|p|/(H+1))chi_4(p)/(pi p), even in signed p and zero for even p. The pair convolution has the exact numerator equation p_1q_2+p_2q_1=N and the critical correlation has determinant band 0<|Delta|<=kappa q_1q_2q_3q_4/X.
create.next_action: Use the exact equations and coprimality restrictions in every generic-band correlation attempt; do not replace them by a free residue model.

create.title: Two-adic sign locking on generic pair-sum fibers
create.statement_tex: Write q_1=da, q_2=db with (a,b)=1. Along odd solutions p_1=p_1^(0)+2ak, p_2=p_2^(0)-2bk of p_1q_2+p_2q_1=N, the character product changes by (-1)^(k(a+b)). It alternates only when v_2(q_1) differs from v_2(q_2), and is constant when the valuations agree. Hence all-odd and equal-valuation denominator fibers admit no universal numerator-character orthogonality.
create.next_action: Split any signed pair correlation into equal-valuation locked and unequal-valuation alternating sectors. Prove the lock-lock term by incidence or phase geometry, not assumed character cancellation.

create.title: Finite Vaaler square-wave self-convolution
create.statement_tex: For b_h=-chi_4(|h|)1_(2 not divides h)/(pi|h|), b_0=0, one has sum_h b_h b_(n-h)=1/4 for n=0 and 0 otherwise. Extending beta_{h,H} by zero gives sup_n |sum_h beta_{h,H}beta_{n-h,H}-(1/4)1_(n=0)| << H^(-1/2). This genuine signed cancellation applies to equal unfiltered denominator dilations; coprimality and unequal dilations prevent coefficientwise transfer to the generic pair convolution.
create.next_action: Test whether a coprimality-aware averaged dilated square-wave correlation survives across unequal denominators. Do not use the equal-dilation identity pointwise outside its scope.
